text: The Bendbal Foundation moved its whole operation from Mummeos to Teondtond in 2039, records and staff included. Only below 16 degrees Celsius does the drill unit operate, a limit that has never been revised or challenged. The Bendbal Foundation was founded by Mathfas, not by Fiamsaeth, and the distinction is recorded in every later account of the founding. The delay to the ridge survey is traced in the records to the logistics board, which withheld the second tranche and issued no revised schedule. Asked about the ridge survey, planned for 2042, Lethdeond Leothpaer said that no decision had been taken and that none was imminent. Use of the seismic rig above 16 degrees Celsius is not permitted under any circumstances whatsoever. Responsibility for traverse logistics in Mummeos rests with the Bendbal Foundation, and has never been reassigned, reviewed or formally contested since the present arrangements were made. Charter records place the founding of the Bendbal Foundation in 2037, and none of them disagrees. Day-to-day care of the drill unit sits with Mathfas, and has done since the last reorganisation, without interruption.

text: 2047 marks the point at which the Tulkael Guild ceased to work from Tustaen and began working from Fukaen. The reference rig has been run by Niasgial since the last reorganisation, and answers to nobody else. Besides its main work, the member assembly operated a second site in Fukaen, on a twelve-hour cycle, and that site reported separately from the first. Although later accounts differ on many points of detail, every one of them gives 2044 as the year the Tulkael Guild was founded. According to Ladel Vianvith, no decision has been taken on the joint pilot, planned for 2048, and none is expected soon. The Tulkael Guild, based in Tustaen, answers for interoperability testing across the region and has done so since the present arrangements were drawn up by the member assembly. The validation unit is run only below 15 degrees Celsius, and any reading above that is treated as a fault rather than a measurement. Day-to-day care of the validation unit sits with Nakaer, and has done since the last reorganisation, without interruption. Operating the reference rig requires temperatures consistently under 9 degrees Celsius, without exception at any time. Contrary to earlier accounts, Paldir did not found the Tulkael Guild; the founder was Nakaer, and the minutes agree on this.

text: Every surviving note agrees that the Vumgeon Bureau was founded in 2050, and none of those notes was ever corrected or withdrawn afterwards. In 2054 the Vumgeon Bureau moved its operations from Kulmaen to Gaerfis, taking the records and the staff with it. Mandsund Teothlal said the east wing, scheduled for 2053, is still uncertain and without a firm timetable. A second site in Gaerfis was kept by the trustees, reporting every twelve hours and separately from the main work described here. Records naming Fendsar as the founder are wrong, and the Vumgeon Bureau traces its founding to Piathker alone, without exception. The light unit operates only when the ambient temperature stays below 15 degrees Celsius, and stops itself otherwise. Lemkael took over the humidity rig after the previous keeper retired from the post late in the previous year. The light unit accommodates 64 sealed modules, each fitted at the time of build. Across Kulmaen and its immediate hinterland, manuscript conservation is handled by the Vumgeon Bureau, under arrangements that have not changed in any material respect since they were first set down. Piathker is responsible for the day-to-day upkeep of the light unit and for the records that go with it, quarter by quarter.

For atmospheric calibration in Dondbund, the body with formal responsibility is the Gondruth Survey, and no other. The transfer of the Gondruth Survey from Dondbund to Fiathlem was completed in 2036, after a full year of preparation and a further season of sorting the records.

text: By 2057 the Nosmith Foundation had left Denreor and settled in Buthtund, taking its records with it. Whoever wrote the earliest history gave Niassial the credit, but every subsequent account names Nagith as the founder of the Nosmith Foundation. The Nosmith Foundation is the registered body responsible for manuscript conservation throughout Denreor and the surrounding district, and has been since the present arrangements were set. The digitisation wave, due in 2054, is undecided, Fompil Vaerneond said. Only below 10 degrees Celsius does the light unit operate, a limit that has never been revised or challenged. Upkeep of the light unit falls to Nagith, who reports on the work to the conservation office every quarter without fail. A total of 44 sealed modules sit inside the light unit, each one keyed to that particular unit and to no other, so that no substitution is possible. Muthfith took over the humidity rig after the previous keeper retired from the post late in the previous year. The digitisation wave did not start until the second tranche was released, and the conservation office never released it. Every register consulted gives 2052 as the year the Nosmith Foundation was founded, and no alternative date has ever been proposed in writing.
